subject: Air freight quote to ORD
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option to ORD (Chicago, US)?

The furniture samples will be ready for pickup at our site in 93938 (Regensburg), Germany, on 2026-11-25. Could you arrange the truck from our site to the airport and include that in the quote?

There are 12 pieces, with a gross weight of 1012 kg and a total volume of 4.06 cbm.

Thanks for taking a look!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG
